title: Detailed lighthouse
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='sky' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#1a2a6c'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#2a4d8f'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='tower' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#f2f2f2'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#c0c8d8'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='0.5' cy='0.5' r='0.5'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#fffde0' stop-opacity='1'/>
      <stop offset='0.5' stop-color='#ffe86b' stop-opacity='0.6'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#ffe86b' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id='sea' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#1e5f8a'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#0d3a5c'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- sea -->
  <rect x='0' y='78' width='100' height='22' fill='url(#sea)'/>
  <path d='M0 78 Q10 74 20 78 Q30 82 40 78 Q50 74 60 78 Q70 82 80 78 Q90 74 100 78 L100 84 Q90 80 80 84 Q70 88 60 84 Q50 80 40 84 Q30 88 20 84 Q10 80 0 84 Z' fill='#3a8fc0' opacity='0.8'/>
  <path d='M0 88 Q15 84 30 88 Q45 92 60 88 Q75 84 90 88 L90 92 Q75 88 60 92 Q45 96 30 92 Q15 88 0 92 Z' fill='#5ab0d8' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- glow beam -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='28' r='26' fill='url(#glow)'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='28' rx='22' ry='6' fill='#fffde0' opacity='0.35'/>

  <!-- rocky base -->
  <path d='M26 76 L32 70 L38 74 L44 69 L50 73 L56 69 L62 74 L68 70 L74 76 Z' fill='#6b6b7a'/>
  <path d='M28 76 L34 72 L40 76 Z' fill='#8a8a9a'/>
  <path d='M58 76 L64 72 L70 76 Z' fill='#8a8a9a'/>

  <!-- tower body -->
  <path d='M40 72 L44 38 L56 38 L60 72 Z' fill='url(#tower)'/>
  <!-- red stripes -->
  <path d='M42.5 58 L57.5 58 L58 64 L42 64 Z' fill='#d9344b'/>
  <path d='M44 42 L56 42 L56.4 47 L43.6 47 Z' fill='#d9344b'/>
  <!-- highlight on tower -->
  <path d='M44 38 L47 38 L44.5 72 L41 72 Z' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- gallery / balcony -->
  <rect x='37' y='34' width='26' height='4' rx='1' fill='#4a4a5a'/>
  <rect x='37' y='34' width='26' height='1.5' rx='1' fill='#7a7a8a'/>
  <!-- railing -->
  <rect x='38' y='31' width='1.5' height='3' fill='#5a5a6a'/>
  <rect x='44' y='31' width='1.5' height='3' fill='#5a5a6a'/>
  <rect x='54' y='31' width='1.5' height='3' fill='#5a5a6a'/>
  <rect x='60' y='31' width='1.5' height='3' fill='#5a5a6a'/>
  <rect x='38' y='30.5' width='24' height='1.2' fill='#5a5a6a'/>

  <!-- lantern room glass -->
  <rect x='43' y='24' width='14' height='10' rx='1' fill='#3a5a8a'/>
  <rect x='43' y='24' width='14' height='10' rx='1' fill='#ffe86b' opacity='0.55'/>
  <!-- lamp -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='28.5' r='3' fill='#fffde0'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='28.5' r='4.5' fill='#ffe86b' opacity='0.4'/>
  <!-- mullions -->
  <rect x='47' y='24' width='1' height='10' fill='#4a6a9a'/>
  <rect x='52' y='24' width='1' height='10' fill='#4a6a9a'/>
  <rect x='43' y='28' width='14' height='0.8' fill='#4a6a9a'/>

  <!-- roof -->
  <path d='M42 24 L50 15 L58 24 Z' fill='#d9344b'/>
  <path d='M50 15 L50 24 L42 24 Z' fill='#b82a3e'/>
  <!-- finial -->
  <rect x='49.3' y='11' width='1.4' height='5' fill='#4a4a5a'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='11' r='2' fill='#d9344b'/>

  <!-- door -->
  <path d='M47 72 L47 65 Q50 62 53 65 L53 72 Z' fill='#5a3a2a'/>
  <path d='M47.5 65 Q50 62.5 52.5 65 L47.5 65 Z' fill='#7a5a3a'/>
  <!-- windows -->
  <rect x='48' y='52' width='4' height='4' rx='1' fill='#3a5a8a'/>
  <rect x='48' y='52' width='4' height='4' rx='1' fill='#ffe86b' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- birds -->
  <path d='M20 20 Q22 18 24 20' stroke='#c0d8f0' stroke-width='1' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M26 16 Q28 14 30 16' stroke='#c0d8f0' stroke-width='1' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M74 22 Q76 20 78 22' stroke='#c0d8f0' stroke-width='1' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
